item: Formatting findings in LF files are called 'only this OS's line ending' (moq4)
notes: Trial 67 (open, unexplained). In moq4 (src/Directory.Build.props LangVersion Latest; C# 14 extension blocks in src/Moq) `bro check` after a clean `bro format` reports 47 WHITESPACE/IDE0055 findings in 7 files (logs: .trials/trial67/moq4/logs/r1-check-report.json) and ignores them as 'only this OS's line ending' (FormatCommand.IsFormattingLine: any whitespace/IDE0055 finding the format copy does not change) although every .cs file is LF. bro format itself rewrote `{ A.B.Count: 1 }` to `Count : 1` (4 spots) and `extension(IMock mock)` to `extension (IMock mock)`, which the host's check then flags again, so the fast record is never marked checked (check 337 s). The build (check --build) reports none of them, only the 3 raw string spots. Not reproducible in a small project. To do: find why the SDK's formatter treats those files differently in moq4; make the line-ending exemption apply only to files that really have the other OS's ending (the findings would then be unfixed: Not clean). Also: `bro check` without a format record before it says Clean for the kept raw string file (the 3 IDE0055 spots are called line endings), while format says Not verified and check --build Not clean.
